params.name: extra_fields
params.description:
A list of extra analytics fields to include in the result. See [here](doc:extra-fields) for a full list. These fields are also listed in this documentation.

Future revisions of this endpoint will include these fields by default. This will _not_ constitute a [breaking change](doc:breaking-change-policy), so we may not give advance notice.
